voice.name: Darius - Engaging Narrator
voice.description: Husky matured male voice with rich texture and commanding tone, ideal for engaging story telling and narrations
voice.note: Public Cartesia stock voice; not a clone of any real person.

beats.narration: Hailie, when I was a kid, I was always the new kid. So I read the dictionary and filled notebooks with rhymes.
I flew to the Rap Olympics with no money and everything riding on one battle. Then Dr. Dre heard my Slim Shady tape and called me into the studio.
The moment that changed everything was the day you were born, on Christmas Day, 1995. Everything I did after that was for you.
Hailie, every word I wrote was so you would never have to grow up the way I did. Keep writing, kid. The words will carry you out.

[VISUAL STYLE]
A shot from a feature-quality 3D animated film, production CG, RenderMan global illumination. Stylized proportions, matte skin with warm subsurface glow through ears and fingertips, matte cloth with weight and few large folds. Not photorealistic, not flat cartoon, no glossy plastic sheen, no film grain.
Lighting: Warm golden-hour late afternoon daylight streaming through window, soft warm bounce, dusty air motes.

[CAMERA AND PERFORMANCE]
Real-time motion, strictly no slow motion. Low-angle gentle tracking shot, child eye-level perspective, gentle camera push forward following the action in a smooth arc.
Action: A young child actively engaged in their childhood world, immersed in the memory of reading the dictionary and filling notebooks with rhymes

[ANIMATION RULES]
Motion: everything winds the opposite way before it moves. Heads and hands travel in gentle curves and arcs, never robotic straight lines. Fast between key poses with a subtle organic overshoot on arrival that settles naturally. Hair and cloth arrive a beat after the body and keep moving a beat past the stop. Every held pose is an organic moving hold with gentle breathing, small weight shifts, and natural blinks. Ground contact has physical weight transfer.
Eye life: continuous micro-saccades, living asymmetric catchlights, natural blink rate, eyes dart to target before the head turns.
Performance: face stays completely honest and sincere; no exaggerated mugging or cartoon pantomime.
